decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler stays close to the core air-cooled heat exchange portfolio and serves process and energy customers at low incremental cost, so keeping it fits the efficiency strategy.
Dropping the overlapping condenser C consolidated the range, so B is now the main single-tube air cooled condenser and its position is stronger, though some risk of further rationalization remains.
Liners for corroded tubes support the high-margin lifecycle service and repair business, which is central to the firm's service strategy.
The customized industrial air cooler line with several models embodies the firm's integrated, customized solutions approach and serves a broad customer base.
Tube end repair inserts strengthen the spare parts and repair offering and extend equipment life with low ongoing resource needs.
